newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's IRI to sell 41 pct in Aeroporti di Roma.
newsitem.headline: Italy's IRI to sell 41 pct in Aeroporti di Roma.

text.p: Italian state holding company IRI plans to sell a 41 percent stake in airport operator Aeroporti di Roma next month, IRI general director Pietro Ciucci was quoted as saying on Saturday.
IRI had previously said the stake up for sale in the firm, which runs Rome's Leonardo Da Vinci airport, would be between 25.62 and 49 percent.
But Ciucci told La Repubblica daily that IRI, which holds 73.58 percent in Aeroporti di Roma, would sell 41 percent.
"We hope to conclude (the operation) next month and we are convinced that interest will be high, since we are bringing a very profitable company to the market," Ciucci said.
Aeroporti di Roma boosted net profits 61 percent in 1996 to 90 billion lire and increased its turnover 11 percent to 1.16
